calibration.environment: macOS Darwin, deterministic Playwright Chromium flags, device scale 1

reference.justification: Compare the frame-owned content only. Omit OS chrome and the part of the screen occupied by required app-only fields; sticky footer is geometrically probed and included in the Chromium baseline. Real labels, a native slider thumb, and no fictitious predecessor/back link differ from the illustrative frame. Keep the previous nonzero budget; reject structural drift independently.

chromium.justification: Keep the existing Chromium cross-platform raster allowance. Mobile light and wide dark screenshots include the real form; structural probes protect dimensions, sticky action placement and access to additional fields.
